item.description:
Note Ferry 1.2.4 fixes bold formatting around Markdown line breaks.
- Bold headings in numbered lists now paste into Apple Notes without visible `**` markers when followed by a Markdown hard line break. - Emphasis spanning a line break keeps its formatting, while list numbering, links, and inline code are preserved.
Version 1.2.4 is build 9. **Format only** still runs locally without AI.

Note Ferry 1.2.3 makes Claude API key setup easier to finish.
- Paste a key directly into Settings, or choose **Paste from clipboard** to save and check it in one step. - Keys that work across workspaces can use a selected workspace. If Note Ferry needs a workspace ID, the key stays saved while you add it. - Key entry uses a regular text field, and saving leaves the clipboard unchanged. - Connection and setup messages are shorter and more specific.
Version 1.2.3 is build 8. **Format only** still runs locally without AI.

Note Ferry 1.2.2 fixes spacing when you use **Format only** on plain text.
- Questions or complete sentences entered on separate lines now become separate, spaced paragraphs instead of running together. - Line breaks within an unfinished sentence remain line breaks. - Markdown documents continue to use Markdown soft-wrap rules.
Version 1.2.2 is build 7. **Format only** still runs locally without AI.

Note Ferry 1.2.1 improves formatting for text pasted into Apple Notes.
- **Preserve table grids.** Markdown tables keep their rows, columns, headers, and wrapped cell text in the preview and rich clipboard output, including tables copied from ChatGPT Meetings. - **Keep bullet wrapping aligned.** Copying selected text from the formatted preview now preserves native list formatting, so wrapped lines align with the item text after pasting into Notes. - **Format meeting action prompts.** ChatGPT Meetings' `codex-prompt` blocks become readable action-item bullets, including when the source is wrapped in an extra code fence. - **Handle more Markdown patterns.** Improved support for nested lists, checklist symbols, quotes, divider lines, alternate heading syntax, image descriptions, and line breaks. Checklist symbols remain text; select the items and use Notes' Checklist button to make them clickable. - **Use a consistent Codex model.** Codex summaries explicitly use GPT-5.6 Sol with medium reasoning effort rather than the installed CLI's default. Your Codex account and CLI must support that model; Note Ferry does not silently switch models if it is unavailable. Unavailable models now show a specific message instead of a generic connection failure.
### Install or update
Choose **Note Ferry → Check for Updates…**, or download **Note-Ferry-1.2.1-universal.zip**, unzip it, and move **Note Ferry.app** to Applications, replacing the previous copy.
Version 1.2.1 is build 6. The universal app supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs and requires macOS 14 or later. Apple Intelligence needs macOS 26 or later and compatible hardware. Runtime testing has been on Apple silicon with macOS 27; Intel hardware and older macOS versions have not been tested. **Format only** continues to run locally without AI.

Note Ferry 1.2 adds a choice of summarizers: Apple Intelligence on compatible Macs, your signed-in Codex account, or a separately billed Claude API key. A first-run screen chooses the default; the picker beside Summarize & format changes it for one text. Format only still runs locally without AI.
Apple Intelligence is the initial choice on a new install and remains experimental. Review names, attribution, and follow-ups, especially in long transcripts. Claude keys are stored in this Mac's Keychain and sent only after a first-use confirmation.

Note Ferry 1.1 adds in-app update checks through Sparkle. You can choose Check for Updates from the Note Ferry menu. On the second launch, the app asks whether it may check automatically in the background.
The rest of the app still formats text locally or summarizes it with your Codex account when you choose that action.
